items.title: Ukrainian lawmaker says Russia is testing Geran-6 high-speed cruise missile
items.summary: Ukrainian parliamentary defence committee member Fedir Venislavskyi reportedly said Russia is testing a compact cruise missile designated Geran-6, expected to reach speeds of up to 1,000 km/h. The statement describes a system under testing rather than confirmed operational deployment.

items.title: Sweden summons Russian ambassador over explosion near its Kyiv embassy
items.summary: Sweden's Foreign Ministry summoned Russia's ambassador to protest an explosion near the Swedish embassy during Russian strikes on Kyiv on November 19, according to the Russian diplomatic mission. The diplomatic protest follows reports of damage or nearby impacts at other foreign missions in Kyiv.

items.title: Jeffrey Sachs urges US to rule out NATO membership for Ukraine and Georgia
items.summary: Economist Jeffrey Sachs said Washington should take the decisive step in dialogue with Moscow by publicly ruling out a US military alliance with Ukraine or Georgia and opposition to their NATO accession. He made the proposal after speaking with Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit in Shenzhen; it is his recommendation, not an announced US policy.
